archive.title: South Side Park
archive.caption: South Side Park was the name used for three different baseball parks that formerly stood in Chicago, Illinois, at different times, and whose sites were all just a few blocks away from each other.

archive.title: 1906 Chicago White Sox season
archive.caption: The 1906 season was the seventh season overall for the Chicago White Sox, and their sixth season in the major leagues. The Sox won their second American League pennant and their first World Series championship.

archive.title: 1906 World Series
archive.caption: The 1906 World Series was the championship series in Major League Baseball for the 1906 season.

archive.title: Comiskey Park
archive.caption: Comiskey Park was a ballpark in Chicago, Illinois, located in the Armour Square neighborhood on the near-south side of the city.

archive.title: 1917 World Series
archive.caption: The 1917 World Series was the championship series of Major League Baseball's (MLB) 1917 season.
